library(plotly)
log_info('Inside contrast visual  ....')

label_work <- gsub('Group','',label)
  label_work_f <- gsub(' ','_',label_work)

log_info('  Vocano plot ....')

data$volcano
ggsave(file.path(path,paste0("Volcano_annotated",".pdf")) , plot=data$volcano2file , dpi = 600, height = 6, width = 10 )
library(DT)
log_info('  Top table rendering ....')

## filter only selected  

table2viz <- data$full_toptable %>% select( Precursor.Id.Id, usage_logFC, usage_se, usage_pval, usage_adjPval,Protein.Group,, Genes, pep_type, total_repeats, start , end , significance, interest )

DT::datatable( table2viz %>% arrange(usage_adjPval)  ,
             extensions = c('FixedColumns', 'Scroller'),
             options = list(fixedColumns = TRUE, scrollY = 400, scrollX = TRUE,
                            scroller = TRUE, dom = 'Bfrtip', autoWidth = TRUE
             ),
 ) %>%  formatRound(columns=c('logFC'), digits=2) %>%
  formatSignif(columns = c('pval', 'adjPval'), digits = 2) 

ttable <- table2viz %>% arrange(adjPval_usage) 
write.csv2(ttable, file= file.path(path,paste0("Toptable",".csv")), row.names=FALSE )
log_info('  Barcode plot rendering ....')
